The '''Administrative Center''' was the headquarters of [[Lant Mining Corporation]], located at the heart of [[Janos]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demar]]. It was a series of four tall metal towers that dominated the city skyline and situated in the middle of the [[Business and Commerce Quarter]].
